title: release r29: cite latest published editions immediately — 12801/13869 handovers completed
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Gate semantic change (owner decision 2026-09-13): published-but-not-yet-effective (upcoming) law versions now support current-hazard citations; repealed/unknown remain excluded. §7/§8/§10 comments and the bundle verifier aligned.
- GB 12801-2025: 82 clauses ingested, 19 hazards re-linked today (the scheduled 10-01 automation is obsolete and removed).
- GB/T 13869-2026: official PDF received, clean text imported (LF_STD_GBT13869_2026), 11 clauses ingested, 13 hazards remapped from the 2017 edition today (the 2027-02-01 switchover script is obsolete and removed).
- validate_all BLOCKING none, gate six-phase PASS (1929 / 2309, strictBlockers=0), audit PASS, bundle verify clean; site-selection -> r29.
